summary: Four tasks, each landing its criterion, verified by dogfooding on this repo as built. forge history reads 300+ committed events nobody could surface and gives unattributed events their own section. Quickfix recording closes the 29/29-empty-files gap at its root with a 13-line passive change to the planning lock that adds a record, never an authorization — confirmed by test and two independent reviews. PR links are durable events that survive a bare clone. The record-origin marker took four review rounds, each closing a distinct way it could state something false (shallow truncation, suppressed boundary, partial-write escape, re-adopt counting real history as preceding); all handled conservatively. The two pre-contract stories are marked, never given a synthesised outcome.
residual_risks: The symlinked-.factory guard is the 5th repository-escape finding across client-writing commands; fixed here, it also triggers deferral D-0003 (audit init/adopt/upgrade against the path-boundary invariant with a test per site) rather than being fully closed by this story.
roadmap.json remains a single mutable file that has lost items to merges twice; making it conflict-free like the 0022 ledgers is named as a separate decision, not done here.
